Job Summary

Associate Geospatial Analyst / Geospatial Analyst / Senior Geospatial Analyst

Map Data. Drive Decisions. Shape the Future.

Are you someone who sees the world in layers—of data, design, and discovery? Do you enjoy transforming information into robust planning, infrastructure, and public service tools? El Paso County is seeking a talented Geospatial Professional to join our Department of Public Works team and help build smarter, more connected communities through innovative GIS and asset management.

This is a career progression opportunity, with openings at the Associate, Analyst, and Senior Analyst levels.
Whether you're just starting your geospatial journey or are a seasoned GIS pro, there’s a place for you here to grow and make an impact.

What You’ll Do

As part of the Geospatial Analyst team, you’ll be key in maintaining and analyzing asset data for transportation systems, public infrastructure, and County resources. You’ll support everything from road maintenance planning and crash data analysis to field data collection and custom map development.
Your work will support day-to-day operations, long-term infrastructure planning, and innovative solutions that make our county run more efficiently. From scripting and database development to GIS app creation and stakeholder collaboration, your expertise will help power decisions that matter.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You have strong technical skills in GIS, asset management systems, and data analysis.
You’re fluent in tools like ArcGIS, SQL, Python, ModelBuilder, and GIS dashboards.
You can turn raw spatial data into actionable insights, maps, and visuals.
You’re a collaborative problem-solver who enjoys working with cross-functional teams.
You have a passion for public service and building tools that improve communities.
You're adaptable, self-motivated, and thrive in a fast-paced, detail-driven environment.

Why Join El Paso County?

Your Work Has Meaning – Help plan and maintain the infrastructure that residents rely on every day.
Room to Grow – Our career progression path means your role grows as your skills do.
Use the Latest Tools – Get hands-on experience with cutting-edge GIS, programming, and asset management systems.
Collaborate Across Departments – Work closely with engineers, planners, field staff, and local agencies.
Be Part of a Mission-Driven Team – We’re passionate about service, innovation, and supporting each other.

We want to hear from you if you’re ready to map your career forward and contribute to impactful projects that shape El Paso County’s future.

Apply today to be part of a geospatial team where your skills and ideas truly make a difference!

Senior Data Analyst will join the Quality and Safety team at Lahey Clinic in Burlington, MA.

Job Description:

Under the general direction of the Manager, Quality Reporting and Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst (SDA) is responsible for the acquisition, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of data to support a range of quality initiatives, provider practice evaluation and performance improvement efforts. A core function of this position is to integrate disparate data sources in new and innovative ways to develop a more comprehensive view of performance. The SDA is responsible for supporting on-going projects and programs by using internal and external data to conduct complex and multi-part analyses to report status updates, and performance based on defined metrics. This position works collaboratively with Medical Staff Office, Patient Safety and Risk, Regulatory and Quality and Safety to assess and determine clinical and business impact, develop reporting and analytic solutions, and make recommendations for actions.

Responsible for accessing, validating, and querying data from data repositories using available tools (including Vizient, RL, NSHN, EPIC, MS Access, SQL, etc.). Sources of data include, but are not limited to, the clinical, operational, financial information systems at the hospital and department level, claims data, and comparative data.
Interpret data; analyze results using statistical techniques, and design reports, dashboards, and visualizations of numerous datasets for various constituents.
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets, using data to locate and define new improvement opportunities, ongoing professional practice evaluation and focused professional practice evaluation.

The role involves serving as a Subject Matter Expert in tools such as QICS, Business Objects, and PowerBI, overseeing quality reporting strategies, and analyzing multi-source data to identify trends for strategic decision-making. Key responsibilities include providing technical support and mentorship, developing solutions to resolve system issues, managing defect trends, and supporting data analytic tools and automation initiatives. The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or related fields, with at least 5 years of experience in data analytics or quality management. Proficiency in PowerBI, PowerApps, Power Automate, SQL, Python, and BI tools is essential, along with strong communication, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills. This onsite position requires collaboration with factory floor teams and is not eligible for visa sponsorship. It offers competitive compensation, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, fostering an environment dedicated to innovation and continuous improvement.
